description: The woman wears a deep burgundy-red opaque gown with a low square neckline, structured fitted bodice and elbow-length outer sleeves. Narrow gold-brown woven borders trim the neckline, shoulder straps, cuffs, waist and floor-length hem. A cream inner dress is visible between the long front panels. A tan-brown patterned wrap lies around her forearms and hangs down both sides, while a decorated belt with a small round clasp and hanging gold fittings sits at the waist. A small pendant necklace is visible. Dark brown leather shoes show beneath the hem, and her head is uncovered.
